verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a domain-notification API for managing opt-in preferences, retrieving schemas and acknowledging lifecycle notifications. That pattern is pull/acknowledge, and the docs also describe polling for registration completion. Neither is a documented, registrable outbound HTTP callback that a programmatic consumer can receive, so it is only adjacent to webhooks. missing for 10: documented webhook subscription endpoint to register callback URLs, list of subscribable event types delivered via HTTP POST, delivery/retry and signature verification docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Manage notification opt-in preferences, retrieve notification schemas, and acknowledge domain lifecycle notifications.
